title: a Bash segment whose program is claude, codex, opencode or pi is denied, through paths, quotes, wrappers, shells and substitutions
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A3 (defect N-24): the guard denies a harness started directly
intended: docs/decisions.md, section "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories" (the guard denies only what starts an agent)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-24, owner answer A3). A worker starts only through the launcher, so a Bash segment whose program is claude, codex, opencode or pi is denied: by name or path, in any letter case, with NAME=value words, quotes or a backslash in the word, behind a wrapper (env, command, exec, nohup, time, sudo, nice, timeout, xargs), behind a shell -c or eval, and in a command substitution, a backtick or a subshell. Only the invocations that start no session pass (hooks/guard/allows-harness-commands-without-a-session). The reason tells the session to start workers through the launcher and ends with (denied: <name>).

reason.regex: ^JITSO owns worker launch in this project: a harness starts only through (bun run jitso|jitso) launch --build <id> --brief <file> --mode <mode>, never as a program of its own\. If the word is text \(a commit message, a heredoc line\), put the text in a file and pass the file\. \(denied: (claude|codex|opencode|pi)\)$
